findings.evidence: The proof is only `simpa using Set.ext_iff.mp (coe_congruenceLattice_mk0_eq_image 𝔪 𝔞) x`, while lines 158–159 establish that equality directly by simplifying `mem_congruenceLattice_iff` with the named fractional-ideal lemmas.
findings.fix: Delete `mem_congruenceLattice_mk0_iff`; consumers needing membership should specialize `mem_congruenceLattice_iff` and simplify with `FractionalIdeal.coe_mk0`, `FractionalIdeal.coeIdeal_mul`, and `FractionalIdeal.mem_coeIdeal`.
findings.issue: `mem_congruenceLattice_mk0_iff` is a specialized restatement of the existing `mem_congruenceLattice_iff`; the immediately preceding set equality also makes it derivable in one line, creating redundant parallel API.

summary: The set equality is a useful new interface, but the membership theorem duplicates an existing general criterion by specialization.
